verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents query-level monitoring that drills down to a single execution with its time breakdown and grouped error signatures. It also exposes the full stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable across the whole cluster, which covers the query-profile half of the story. Execution-plan inspection (e.g. EXPLAIN) is never mentioned and is only implied by 'same SQL' ClickHouse compatibility. Per-query cost or resource attribution is not described either. Missing for 10: explicit execution-plan/EXPLAIN support, per-query resource or cost breakdown, independent or hands-on corroboration.
